text: Amortised denoising: one tiny denoise step per frame, with certainty used as a per-pixel noise level
description: Newly revealed pixels start at noise level ≈ 1, while reprojected ones keep their remaining noise level and get one more step each frame. At 90 Hz that's 90 steps per second. Related: Diffusion Forcing (per-token noise levels), Rolling Diffusion, FIFO-Diffusion (diagonal denoising queue for infinite video), StreamDiffusion. The network is the pull-push U-Net with certainty logic, conditioned on the noise-level map.
